answer: The sable I would price into every new account is Audited conservation volunteer record with conservation trust attestation: seasons the trust recorded across years of volunteers, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the knoll of that gap is the whole defence in one line. Time is the tax here: seasons the trust recorded across years of volunteers cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the grove for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
